paite: Bil na doh un, vante aw, ka gen ding hi. Lei aw, ka kam a thu za in.
heading: Mosi La
english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

paite: Vuahtui bang in ka thu azu ding a, Daitui bang in ka thugen atak ding. Loupa nou dipdip tung a vuah bang leh lounah tung a vuah phin bang in.
english: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

paite: TOUPA min ka puan ding ziak in Thupina i Pathian pia un.
english: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

paite: Amah suangpi ahi, Athilhih adik kim sipsip hi. A-omdan tengteng dan ahi. Pathian muanhuai, thulimlouhna nei lou, diktat leh hoih ahi.
english: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

paite: Amau leh amau akihihsia ua, atate ahi kei uh, gensiat alohna uh ahi, suan gina lou leh genhak ahi uhi.
english: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

paite: Mihai leh pilloute aw, huchi in maw, TOUPA na thuk ding uh? Nou hon suang, na pa uh ahi kei maw? Ahon bawl a, ahon dingkipsak hi.
english: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

paite: Nidanglai nite theigige inla, suan tampi kumte ngaihtuah dih. Na pa dong in, ahon kawkmuh ding, na upate'n leng ahon hilh ding uhi.
english: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

paite: Tungnungpen in namte gam apiak lai a, mihing tate akhen lai in namte gamgi Israel suante zah in akhung hi.
english: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

paite: TOUPA tantuan zaw amite ahi ua; Jakob lah agoutan ahi.
english: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

paite: Gamdai gam ah amu a, gamdai sia mau honhon ah, akim ua omkhum in akem a, Amit laivom bang in akem hi.
english: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

paite: Muvanlai in abu a anou tokthou a, anou tung ah kha azap a, akhate azak a, atuah a, akha a apuak bang in;
english: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

paite: Gamdang pathian hilou in TOUPA kia in api zel hi.
english: Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

paite: Lei mun sangte ah atuangsak a, lou a thil tung ane zel a; suangpi a pan khuaizu akikhohkhesak zel a, suang tak a pan thau toh;
english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

paite: Ganhon a pan nawitui khal, belamhon a pan nawitui, belamnou thau toh, Bashan uain na dawn ding.
english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

paite: Himahleh Jeshurun ahong thau a, ahong kipek a; na thau a, na sapha a, na maitai a; abawlpa Pathian alehngatsanta, hotdamna Suangpi angaineu hi.
english: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

paite: Gamdang pathiante'n i Pathian mullitna atokthou a, thilkihhuai in ahehsak hi.
english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

paite: Pathian hilou, dawite kiang ah atheih ngei louh uh pathiante kiang ah, ahong khonung om phing pathian thakte, na pi, na pute un akihtak ngei louh uh kiang ah.
english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

paite: Nang hon suang Suangpi па ngaisang kei, nang hon bawlpa Pathian na mangngilh lai hi.
english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

paite: Huai TOUPA'N amu a, amudah a, atanu leh tapate'n ahihheh ziak un.
english: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

paite: Ka bukmang san dia, atawpna uh bang ahi dia chih ka en ding, achi hi. Suan thulim lou ginna nei lou tate ahi uhi.
english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

paite: Pathian hilou thil in ka mullitna atokthou ua; athil gina lou un ahon hehsak uh; chi a genlouhte ka mullitsak dia, nam haite in ka hehsak ding hi.
english: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

paite: Ka hehna akuang a, gawtmun nuainungpen tan in akang a, lei leh athilpung akang ding, tangte kingaknate mei in akang ding hi.
english: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

paite: Atung uah siatna ka chiangkhawm dia, atung uah thal ka khah ding.
english: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

paite: Gilkial in agongthak ding ua, meisa leh siatna in akangmang ding ua, atung uah gamsa hate ka sawl dia, leivui agulte gu toh.
english: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

paite: Nungak, tangval, nawi ne lai, lu a kelsam poute tanpha in polam ah namsau in asi ding ua, sunglam ah launa in.
english: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

paite: Ke'n, ka delhzak vek ding, mihing lak a amau theihgigena ka hihmang vek ding.
english: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

paite: Melma thangpaihna lau lou hi leng, amelmate un theikhial in, i khut uh tawisang in a-omta, huai teng TOUPA hih ahi kei, achi kha ding uhi, ka chi hi.
english: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; Yahweh has not done all this.’”

paite: Pilna nei lou namte ahi ua, amau ah theihsiamna a-om kei.
english: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

paite: Aw, pil le uh hiaite atheisiam ding ua, atunung thu uh ngaihtuah ding hi ve un!
english: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

paite: Bangchi in khat in sang adelh dia, nih in sing ataikeksak ding ua, a Suangpi un amaute akhawng khinta hi, TOUPA'N amaute apiakkhiak kei ngalleh?
english: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?

paite: Asuangpi uh lah i melmate mahmah theihdan in leng i Suangpi bang ahi kei hi.
english: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

paite: Agrepgui uh Sodom grepgui ahi a, aloute uh Gomorrah loute ahi. Agrepte uh sinkha grepte ahi uh, agahbomte akha hi.
english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

paite: A-uainte uh dragon gu leh gulgial gu khatak ahi.
english: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

paite: Hiai ka kholkhawm, ka goubawm a bilh bikbek ahi kei maw?
english: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

paite: Phulak leh thuk zaw kei hih ding ahi, asiksan uh ateu hun chiang in; asiatna ni uh ahong naita, atung ua thil hong tung dingte ahong tungpahta ding hi.
english: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

paite: TOUPA'N amite avaihawm ding, asikhate leng alainat ding, athilhihtheihna uh abei chih leh kuamah sikha leh noplen a-om kei, chih amuh chiang in.
english: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

paite: Ama'n apathiante uh koi ah, amuan suangpi uh koi ah;
english: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

paite: akithoihna thau netute, adawn thillat uain dawntute? Hong thou in nou hong panpih uhenla, nou hon humbittute hi le uh ake, achi ding.
english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

paite: Kei, kei mahmah ka hihthei unla, pathian dang a-om kei. Ka that a, ka hingsak a, ka liamsak a, ka damsak hi. Ka khut a pan noute hon hunkhe thei kuamah a-om kei uhi.
english: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

paite: Van lam ah ka khut ka zak a, keimah ka hin bang in ka kichiam hi.
english: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

paite: Ka namsau tat-hiam a, ka khut a vaihawmna ka letleh ka melmate tung ah phu ka la dia, kei hon hote ka thuk ding hi.
english: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

paite: Ka thaltangte asisan uah ka diah dia, ka namsau in sa teng ka that bei dia; thahte leh salte sisan toh melmate tung a phulakna a kipan, achi ding hi.
english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

paite: Aw, nou nam chihte aw, amite toh kipak un; asikhate sisan phuba ala ding hi. Amah doute tung ah phu ala ding, agam leh amite a ding in kilemna bukim abawl ding.
english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

paite: Huchi in mipite zak in Mosi leh Nun tapa, Joshua in hiai la thu tengteng agen uhi.
english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

paite: "Mosi in huai thu tengteng Israel mi tengteng kiang a agen khit in, akiang uah;
heading: Mosi Thuhilhna Nanung
english: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

paite: Tua na kiang ua ka hon thu theihsak ah na lungtang uh koihkip unla, hiai dan tengteng pilvang mahmah a zui ding in na tate uh thu pia un.
english: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

paite: Nou a ding in thil bangmah lou lel ahi kei a, na hinna uh ahi ngal a. Hiai thilhih in luah dia Jordan na va galkahna gam uah na damsawt ding uhi," achi hi.
english: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

paite: Huai ni mah in TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

paite: "Moab gam a Jeriko zawn a Abarim tang dung a Nebo tang ah va hohtou inla, Israel suante luah dia ka piak Kanaan gam va gal-et in.
english: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

paite: Na sanggampa Aaron Hor tang a si a, achipihte kiang a pi ahih tak mah bang in na kahtouh na tang ah na si dia, na chipihte kiang a pi na hita ding hi.
english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

paite: Zin gamdai a Meribah-kadesh tui munte a Israel suante lak a ka tung a na khelh ziak in leh Israel suante lak a na hon pahtawi louh ziak in.
english: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

paite: Tua gam na va galmuh dia; himahleh Israel suante ka piak gam ah na lut kei ding," achi hi.
english: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
